subject: Request: keep NovaPath pilot live while procurement completes
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novapath.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novapath.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 08:45:12 -0700
Subject: Pilot timing — procurement slowing PO, can we avoid expiry?

Hi Michael / Camila,

Quick update from our side: our procurement and vendor onboarding team flagged a few missing items and asked for a signed SOW plus W-9 before they can issue a PO. They expect that process to take about 7–10 business days, which would push past the pilot window.

The product and clinical teams are mid-integration and losing access would set us back. Is there a way for Redwood to keep the pilot environment live for NovaPath while finance completes the vendor steps? If needed we can provide the SOW redline and a firm ETA for the PO.

Thanks — appreciate any short-term options.

—Sarah
Sarah Liu
Head of Clinical Programs
NovaPath Health

Attachment: NovaPath_MVP_usage.csv (csv, 48 KB)

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novapath.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Sep 2026 10:02:37 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot timing — procurement slowing PO, can we avoid expiry?

Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for the usage export.

We can support a short-term keepalive while procurement completes. Two quick clarifying items before I confirm internally:

1) Can you share the PO ETA (best case / firm case) and whether procurement requires a revised SOW or just a signature?
2) Will NovaPath need full prod capacity or a reduced sandbox footprint for the interim? Reduced footprint helps us approve a smaller staged voucher.

If procurement can give a firm PO date within 10 business days, I can propose a staged bridge: a 10-day token voucher (10,000 inference units) and access to the existing pilot environment. That keeps the integration work live and limits our exposure.

I'm attaching an updated Mutual Action Plan (v2) that lists the items procurement usually requests; Camila, can you look at this and confirm internal approval process for a 10k voucher? Naomi, I copied you for finance/ops sign-off.

Next steps: Sarah — send the PO ETA and note on SOW status. I’ll route the voucher ask for quick approval and follow up with the exact terms.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: MutualActionPlan_v2.pdf (pdf, 210 KB)

On Tue, Sep 1, 2026 at 10:02 AM Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai> wrote:
> If procurement can give a firm PO date within 10 business days, I can propose a staged bridge...

Hi Michael — thanks for engaging.

Short answers: our best-case official PO date is 2026-09-10; the firm case is 2026-09-15 while the legal team reviews a one-line SOW redline. We do need a signed SOW and current W-9 on file.

We appreciate the offer of a temporary voucher. Two conditions from NovaPath finance:
- The voucher must be limited (documented token/usage cap) and timebound;
- We need confirmation of billing terms that will apply once the PO is live (so we can budget).

If Redwood can provide the voucher terms now (cap + expiry + post-PO billing rate), procurement will escalate internally and try to hit 9/10.

Regards,
Procurement Team
NovaPath Health

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@novapath.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@novapath.com>

On Wed, Sep 2, 2026 at 09:15 AM Procurement Team <procurement@novapath.com> wrote:
> our best-case official PO date is 2026-09-10; the firm case is 2026-09-15...

Thanks — this is helpful.

We’re prepared to issue a one-time, timebound bridge to keep the pilot live while your PO clears. Summary of the offer: 

- Staged voucher: 10,000 inference units (equivalent to ~10k token units for current pilot workload)
- Validity window: 10 days from activation
- Post-PO billing: standard Enterprise meter rates per the RedBook ratecard; any usage beyond voucher will be billed after the PO is processed
- Administrative: Redwood requires a simple form acknowledging the voucher and confirming the expected PO date (we can share a stub).

I’ve attached the trial_bridge_terms.txt (legal-friendly summary) — this is deliberately short; our legal ops has pre-approved similar keeps for cases where procurement is the sole blocker. Camila / Naomi — please treat this as an expedited approval; I’ll mark the HubSpot deal with the voucher terms (link below).

Sarah / Procurement — if that looks acceptable, reply to confirm the PO ETA and we’ll activate the voucher immediately on confirmation. If you need the SOW redline back tonight, I can send it to your legal mailbox for a one-page signature.

Thanks and let me know if you want a 15-day window instead (we can discuss internally but prefer 10-day to limit exposure).

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Attachment: trial_bridge_terms.txt (text, 3 KB)
